clues: This city stands in a rich, well-watered valley on a river. It is in the far south of Turkey, near the Levantine Sea.
Summers here are hot and dry, and winters are mild and wet. Its high ground keeps it a bit cooler than the coast near by.
This city was founded in the fourth century BC by a great empire. It grew to be one of the largest cities of the Roman world.
A new name for the followers of a faith was first used here. The holy book says the word Christian first came up in this city.
In 2023, two strong quakes hit this city hard. They broke old sites, and one was the Church of St Paul.
